text:
incident-bot: ALERT — dedicated pool 'marigold-prod-vpc' GPU utilization 98% (sustained 3m). Tenant=MARIGOLD (single-enterprise). queue depth rising, tail latency spiking. auto-threshold: gpu_util>95%. paging #oncall. incident_id=INC-2026-1768523333
ryan_oncall: I'm on it. tagging infra + SRE. any immediate customer-visible errors?
lee_sre: seeing 5% 503s and median token latency +350ms over baseline. KV cache hit-rate has dropped from 92% -> 53% last 10m (kv eviction thrash).
lina_ops: autoscaler attempted to add nodes but no spare GPUs in region (AZ-a). shared burst pool shows 0 available GPUs right now.
jay_infra: quick options: 1) manual burst from 'shared-burst-1' if billing/account ok, 2) evict low-priority background tenants (risky), 3) immediate model-fallback routing to smaller replica for this tenant (may affect quality).
maria_sa: looping in account team and Marigold CSM. I'll ask for permission for a short manual burst and give heads-up re billing. pinging @account_ops now.
ryan_oncall: prioritize customer availability. Approve manual burst up to 30m if account approves. Meanwhile throttle non-prod and background queues for this tenant by 20% and enable short-term rate limit on heavy endpoints.
lee_sre: executing mitigations now: increasing prefix cache TTL, disabling large-batch inference for marigold route, and enabling request-level rate limit. Running commands:```sh
# increase cache TTL
runtime-cli cache set --tenant marigold --prefix-ttl 120s
# disable large batches for tenant
runtime-cli config set --route "marigold.gen" batch.max_tokens 256
# temp rate limit
runtime-cli rate-limit set --route "marigold.gen" rps 80
```
lina_ops: autoscaler still stuck. If account denies burst we need to keep throttles and consider shifting traffic to hosted fallback model (lower quality) — do we want that path?
jay_infra: I can free up one GPU by draining low-priority pool 'background-2' (evict jobs). That buys ~12 minutes while shared-burst approval comes through. Need explicit go.
ryan_oncall: go ahead with background-2 drain, mark jobs for restart + best-effort. maria_sa, any sign from account?
maria_sa: account team responded: verbal OK for 30m manual burst understanding additional invoice. Customer prefers we avoid evictions if possible. They requested a brief notice to ops inbox. I've messaged marigold-contact@ and sent email.
jay_infra: manual burst command (requires approver token). Using oncall token now:```sh
infra-cli burst approve --pool shared-burst-1 --tenant marigold --duration 30m --approved-by ryan_oncall --reason "prod saturation"
```
incident-bot: BURST_APPROVED by ryan_oncall at 1768523380. Allocating 2 GPUs from shared-burst-1 -> marigold-prod-vpc.
lee_sre: rebalancer running, queue draining. tail latency trending down: now +90ms, 503s -> 0.9%. Cache hit-rate back to 85%. Good.
pm_sasha: creating incident ticket INC-2026-1768523333 in tracker, assigning SRE+Infra+Eng-oncall. Scheduling 60m postmortem sync in 24h.
ryan_oncall: current plan: monitor for next 30m. If stable, release burst 10m early and start remediation work: enforce autoscale fallback, add capacity alert tuning, and scope runaway traffic patterns.
lee_sre: noted follow-ups: (1) add region fallback for autoscaler, (2) implement tenant-level graceful degrade route to hosted small-model, (3) add post-incident billing summary for customer and internal chargeback.
pm_sasha: tagging for PM+CS review. Closing live mitigation channel once burst drains and metrics stable for 10m. :white_check_mark:
